title: Panexperientialism is a nonreductive form of physicalism

statements.text: Panexperientialism shares most theses of physicalism: every actuality has a physical aspect, every actual occasion has a determinate location in spacetime, only physical entities exert causal efficacy, and the causal nexus is never interrupted. It differs on the nature of the stuff and on self-determination, and so offers a fourth option beside reductive materialism, eliminative materialism and dualism.

sources.quote: In Whitehead’s system every actual occasion has a determinate spatiotemporal location relative to all others
I have proposed a fourth option: a nonreductive, panexperientialist physicalism.
